doc: Input state sampled by the host once per host frame. Buttons are a device-independent pad the host maps from keyboard and gamepad; keys are PC set-1 scan codes (the values of DirectInput DIK_* and of Eden's KeyCode).

functions.name: buttons
functions.doc: Held buttons of pad `pad` (0 = the first player) as a BUTTON_* mask; 0 for a pad that does not exist.

functions.name: key_down
functions.doc: Whether the key with this set-1 scan code is held; false outside 1..MAX_SCANCODE.

functions.name: mouse_buttons
functions.doc: Held mouse buttons as a MOUSE_* mask.

functions.name: mouse_delta
functions.doc: Movement of the mouse along AXIS_* since the previous host frame, in pixels (wheel: notches); 0 for an unknown axis.
